company.shortDescription: Idemeum is an Endpoint Protection Platform
company.description: Idemeum is a unified endpoint protection platform that combines multiple security products in one. Idemeum offers Application Allowlisting, Endpoint Privilege Management, and Just-in-time Privileged Access.
